items.html: And let us return to the matter, that this point was at first a tail for the lions at the end of Atzilut, for Eve was a tail for Adam. And afterward she descended and diminished herself in the secret of her point, and became a head for foxes, literally a head for Beriah. And so it was in every world, for the point of Malchut of Yetzirah descended at the head of Assiyah, and likewise that of Beriah at the head of Yetzirah.
